name: District 4 Future Leaders Program
org: Orange County Board of Supervisors, District 4
what_you_do: Build your leadership skills, explore careers, and learn how local government works.
who_can_apply: You must be in 10th or 11th grade and live in the county's 4th District. It covers Brea, Buena Park, Fullerton, La Habra, Placentia, Stanton and parts of Anaheim.
pay_detail: The county does not list pay or cost. Lunch was provided in 2025.
deadline_text: The 2026 form is closed and 2026 dates are not posted as of Nov 2, 2026. The newest dates we have are from 2025: forms were due April 10, 2025, and sessions ran June 7, 14, 21 and 28.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form on the program page when it opens. Both the 2025 and 2026 forms are closed now. Email to ask about the next round.
notes: The county has not posted a 2027 round, so ask before you plan on it. Questions: D4.FutureLeaders@ocgov.com or (714) 834-3440.
